calls.title: No Name & GrowthBook
calls.summary: During the meeting, pricing and contract negotiation were prioritized, resulting in a discounted rate of $25,000 for 600 experiments and 25 users, marking a 60% reduction from the standard price. Key security features like role-based access control (RBAC) were confirmed as essential for the client's purchase decision. The contract preparation and signing process was outlined, with a swift legal review expected to take one to two days to facilitate a timely agreement. Furthermore, the discussion covered the latest product capabilities in versions 4.3 and 4.4, including AI-driven analytics, emphasizing the client’s intention to double their experimentation volume. To maintain engagement, both parties scheduled a follow-up meeting next week, reinforcing open communication and collaboration throughout the negotiation.
calls.keywords: monetization policy, pricing model, experiments, seats, GrowthBook, AI analytics
